versions.changelog:
ai-clipping v1.0.6

- Added support for AI-generated attention-grabbing text hooks in exported clips with new flags: --ai-hook, --ai-hook-style, and --ai-hook-pos.
- Updated recommended workflow to use --export and --ai-hook by default for more engaging clip outputs.
- Expanded export resolution options to support QHD_2K and UHD_4K in addition to existing resolutions.
- Updated caption style template default for --caption-display=both (now uses temp-static-2); for other modes, now defaults to word-focus.
- Documentation improvements to reflect new options and defaults.

- Default export video resolution increased from HD_720 to FHD_1080 for higher quality clips.
- Small improvements to workflow instructions for polling script and subagent usage.
- Clarified fallback recommendation: if the API can't fully satisfy the user's request, suggest using the Wayin.ai online video editor.
- Various minor documentation clarifications and improved tips for robust results reporting.
- No functional or code changes; this is a documentation update only.

No user-facing changes detected in this version.

- No updates or modifications found compared to the previous release.
- All instructions, descriptions, and metadata remain unchanged.

- Improved subagent monitoring: agents now check subagent status every 2 × event interval for better progress updates during polling.
- Clarified instructions for updating users on the status of processing when reminders or events are received.
- Added guidance for agents to inform users of the absolute result file path after success.
- Minor documentation and clarity updates to workflow and monitoring steps.

- Added a new --save-dir option to the extract clips step, allowing users to customize where the initial result JSON file is saved (default is now api_results).
- Clarified that the result JSON file will be saved in your workspace, and updated wording for consistency.
- Adjusted subagent reference and polling instructions to improve clarity, especially regarding result reporting and usage of --event-interval with OpenClaw.
- No code or file changes; documentation update only.

- Improved background processing and monitoring by recommending the use of the `--event-interval 300` flag with the polling script for continuous progress updates, especially in OpenClaw environments.
- Clarified that subagents should always be preferred for polling tasks, and system event reminders are now triggered periodically when `--event-interval` is enabled.
- Adjusted subagent reporting instructions: subagents now report raw script output after redacting sensitive information, instead of verbatim output.
- Improved workflow guidance for handling reminders and updating users on processing status during long-running tasks.

ai-clipping 1.0.0

- Initial release introducing AI-powered highlight extraction for quick viral clip generation.
- Supports input from both popular video platforms and local files with automatic upload if needed.
- Exports ready-to-share clips with customizable aspect ratios, resolutions, caption styles, and AI reframing.
- Output can include subtitles, rendered clips, or raw analysis results—optimized for social media and highlight reels. 
- Supports background processing and notifies users of status, with direct delivery of all export/download links.
